design_configuration.nominal_note: Approximate artistic design envelope, not measured fossil size; measured source and GLB XYZ bounds recorded separately after build.
design_configuration.interpretation: Two visibly separated descending whorls; continuous gradually thickening tube with subdued transverse ribs; broad terminal U hook and actual recessed aperture. Correct ImageGen planar/disconnected ambiguity into continuous 3D centerline. No soft body, species, locality or specimen-copy claim. Hidden rear is continuous helical tube, aperture has real inner wall and blind deep fossil cavity.
design_configuration.revision_reason: Repair dark twist seam at vertical hook tangent using transported tube frames; preserve open-helix and hook silhouette.
